summary: Tested 3 P0 features: (1) 'Serious Relationships Only' landing branding — visually confirmed hero text, dedicated badge, and 'No hookups — only meaningful relationships' copy render on production URL. (2) Safety Ban duration system — backend pytest suite (6/6 passing) verifies POST /api/admin/safety-ban accepts duration ('24h','7d','permanent') and sets ban_expires_at correctly; GET /api/admin/safety-banned-users returns ban_duration/ban_expires_at/is_permanently_banned fields; auto_unban_checker background task exists and is scheduled on startup (30-min interval). Frontend Playwright confirmed clicking 'Ban User' in Safety Dashboard Alerts subtab opens the ban-duration-modal with all 3 data-testid options (ban-24h, ban-7d, ban-permanent) visible. (3) Custom AI persona — verified CUSTOM_PERSONA_SHIVAM constant exists in ai_chatbot.py and _generate_stealth_response gates it on user email == 'shivamkks545@gmail.com'.

issues: 'Enjoying HeartLink?' rating modal auto-appears over the admin dashboard shortly after navigation, partially blocking Safety Dashboard interactions. Admin sessions should probably suppress the rating prompt. Minor UX polish, not blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress 'Enjoying HeartLink?' rating modal for admin users / on /admin route to avoid overlay on Safety Dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: safety_ban_user endpoint (server.py L8707) has no admin auth guard — anyone with the URL can ban a user. Recommend adding admin dependency check.
safety_unban_user and safety-banned-users endpoints likewise appear unauthenticated. Verify Depends(get_current_admin) is applied via router prefix or add explicitly.
auto_unban_checker uses asyncio.sleep(30*60) at loop start — on startup it waits 30 min before first check; consider running once immediately then sleeping.
server.py is ~9725 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline; should be split into routers per domain.
